label: History
value: Anne Shirley arrives in Avonlea.
unit: Anne Shirley arrives in Avonlea after being sent from an orphan asylum to Green Gables, where siblings Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert originally intended to adopt a boy to help on the farm. Impressed by her spirit and imagination, they decide to keep her. Anne quickly swears a solemn oath of eternal friendship with her neighbor Diana Barry, though her explosive temper causes an early clash with Rachel Lynde. At Avonlea school, she develops a fierce academic rivalry and deep grudge against Gilbert Blythe after he calls her 'Carrots.' Over the years, Anne's quick mind and dramatic nature lead to various mishaps, including accidentally intoxicating Diana with currant wine, breaking her ankle walking a roof ridgepole, accidentally flavoring a cake with anodyne liniment, and accidentally dying her hair green. However, she earns the lifelong gratitude of the Barry family by saving Diana's sister Minnie May during a bout of croup. She joins the Queen's Academy preparation class under Miss Stacy's guidance, ties with Gilbert for first place on the Island Entrance examinations, and later wins the prestigious Avery Scholarship at Queen's Academy. Following Matthew's sudden death, Anne decides to forego attending Redmond College to remain at Green Gables and support Marilla, accepting a position as the local schoolteacher in Avonlea.

value: Gilbert spent three years in Alberta.
unit: Gilbert spent three years in Alberta due to his father's ill health, missing out on regular schooling before returning to Avonlea. Upon returning from a summer visit to New Brunswick, he rejoined the Avonlea school under Mr. Phillips. On his first day back, he provoked Anne Shirley by teasingly pulling her braid and calling her "carrots," sparking a years-long academic rivalry and personal grudge on her part despite his sincere attempts to apologize. Later, when Anne was stranded on a bridge pile during a play-acting mishap at Barry's Pond, Gilbert rescued her in a dory and offered friendship, though she again rejected him. He subsequently attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne, electing to take the intensive Second Year course to earn a First Class teacher's license in one year and competing as a top contender for the Governor-General's Medal. Upon completing his studies, Gilbert secured the Avonlea school teaching position; however, upon learning that Anne desired to stay near home to care for Marilla, he selflessly withdrew his application in her favor and accepted a position at White Sands instead.

Following Matthew's sudden death from a heart attack, Marilla openly confesses her deep love and gratitude to Anne.

value: Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables.
unit: Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with his sister Marilla. Due to his advancing age and failing heart, he and Marilla arranged to adopt a young boy from an asylum to help on the farm. Upon driving to Bright River station, he found Anne Shirley waiting instead, and despite his terror of little girls, he immediately took a liking to her endless chatter. Matthew quietly insisted on keeping Anne at Green Gables, gradually persuading Marilla to agree. He became Anne's devoted friend and supporter, taking great delight in indulging her, including secretly getting her a stylish dress with puffed sleeves. Years later, Matthew died instantly of a heart attack on the kitchen threshold after reading news of the failure of the Abbey Bank.
